rules.why: The tooltip is a role="tooltip" popover with an id the trigger points to.
The icon is paint; the text speaks.

manual.why: Only a focusable element gets a tooltip, through aria-describedby (or aria-labelledby when it is the name).
What the tooltip says is never essential.
Exactly one trigger points to the tooltip, through aria-labelledby or aria-describedby - never both; the tooltip comes right after it (rule 25).
Inside the tooltip: the icon and the text, nothing else, nothing interactive; data-placement is top, bottom, left or right.
